reference_donor.pattern: factory-only RetinaAssessment with dataclass(init=False), fail-closed public __init__, module-private object.__new__ producer, produced-instance validation, and direct-constructor/dataclasses.replace falsifiers

recommended_delta.class_change: Change PerceptionControlResult to @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True, init=False).
recommended_delta.public_constructor: Define __init__(*args, **kwargs) that always raises PerceptionControlError with an explicit producer-lineage/factory-only message.
recommended_delta.validation_move: Move current __post_init__ field/control validation into a private _validate_produced() method without relaxing any existing OFF, taint, policy_sha256, value/confidence, egress, memory or persistence invariant.
recommended_delta.single_producer: Add module-private _produce_perception_control_result(...) that uses object.__new__(PerceptionControlResult), assigns the complete result envelope, calls _validate_produced(), then returns the result.
recommended_delta.evaluator_binding: Replace every direct PerceptionControlResult(...) branch in evaluate_perception_head() with _produce_perception_control_result(...). No external caller should be able to use the ordinary constructor to mint an evidence-bearing or persistence-allowed result.
recommended_delta.serialized_schema: Do not add a claimed cryptographic producer field for this scope. Preserve the current serialized/as_dict schema unless a downstream ABI explicitly needs a producer label; a copied label or digest would not itself prove lineage.
tests: Canonical evaluate_perception_head() result remains behaviorally identical at all ON/COMPUTE_OFF/OUTPUT_OFF/MEMORY_OFF branches.
Direct PerceptionControlResult(...) with exact legitimate registry_sha256 and policy_sha256 but forged OK/persistence_allowed=True must raise.
dataclasses.replace(canonical_result, ...) must raise rather than mint a producer-looking variant.
Existing policy digest, transitive compute taint, transitive memory/persistence taint and error/unknown-head tests remain green.
No runtime/whole-system credit is granted by component CI.

threat_model.closed: Ordinary repository/API-level direct construction and dataclasses.replace laundering inside trusted cooperative F2 code.
threat_model.not_closed: Arbitrary malicious Python code in the same interpreter using object.__new__, object.__setattr__, monkeypatching, reflection, debugger access, or code execution inside the module trust boundary.
threat_model.escalation_condition: If PerceptionControlResult must be verified across mutually untrusted processes or persisted/re-hydrated as an independently verifiable statement, introduce an EvaluationReceipt/attestation envelope with producer identity, evaluation/invocation identity, exact input/material digests and subject/result digest, authenticated by a signer/key outside the untrusted producer process.

external_architecture_mapping.SLSA_in_toto: Distill the separation of subject/result identity from producer/builder identity and invocation details; do not import the supply-chain frameworks into the current in-process component.
external_architecture_mapping.Python: Non-public naming is not a hard privacy boundary. dataclass(init=False) plus a fail-closed constructor is therefore a typed correctness/provenance fence, matching the already accepted WP700 scope rather than a security sandbox.
